scholarships.title: 2026 Call for PhD Studentships – Regular Line of Application (FCT)

existing.description: The Foundation for Science and Technology runs an annual call for PhD studentships under its Regulation for Studentships and Fellowships (RBI) and Research Fellowship Holder Statute (EBI). The regular line of application covers all scientific areas and funds research carried out in scientific and academic institutions, including public and private higher education institutions, R&D units, Associated Laboratories and other private non-profit R&D bodies, at home or abroad. Selected applicants receive a monthly allowance plus complementary support such as tuition fees, support for additional training, presentation of work at scientific meetings, personal accident insurance and, where applicable, travel and relocation costs. In the 2026 call FCT received 3,628 applications and approved 1,000, a total funding value of 90,625,000 EUR, an approval rate of 28%.
eligibility: Enrolled in, or meeting the requirements to enrol in, a PhD programme leading to a doctoral degree
Portuguese, EU member state, third-state, stateless or political-refugee citizenship
Must not have previously held an FCT-funded PhD studentship or PhD in Industry studentship, regardless of its duration
Must not already hold a doctoral degree
Must live in Portugal permanently and habitually if applying for a studentship based both in Portugal and abroad or entirely abroad
Remaining admissibility requirements are set out in section 4 of the Notice of the Call
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to applicants enrolled in, or meeting the requirements to enrol in, a PhD programme leading to a doctoral degree. Portuguese citizens, EU member state citizens, third-state citizens, stateless citizens and beneficiaries of political refugee status may all apply. Applicants must not previously have held an FCT-funded PhD studentship or PhD in Industry studentship, must not already hold a doctoral degree, and must live in Portugal permanently and habitually if applying for a studentship based both in Portugal and abroad or entirely abroad.
benefits: Presentation of work at scientific meetings
Travel and relocation costs where applicable
coverage: Presentation of work at scientific meetings
Travel and relocation costs where applicable
requirements: Apply online using exclusively the application form at myfct.fct.pt, selecting the regular line of application; applications or extra information sent by any other means will not be accepted
Submit between the opening and closing dates published for the call
Ensure the Contracting Institution indicated in the form validates the application within its 10-working-day window, because unvalidated applications are excluded from the call
Submit proof of degree recognition where a foreign qualification is being converted
Meet the admissibility requirements in section 4 of the Notice of the Call
documents: The application form submitted through myFCT, with the supporting documents listed in the FCT Regulation for Studentships and Fellowships (RBI) and in the Notice of the Call
Proof of recognition of conversion of degrees or diplomas awarded by foreign institutions, where the qualification was awarded abroad
Documents listed in the Application Guide published with the call
application_method: Register or sign in at myfct.fct.pt
Select the regular line of application and start the application
Complete the form and attach the documents listed in the RBI and the Notice of the Call
Submit before the published closing time
Ask the Contracting Institution to validate the application within its 10-working-day period
existing.selection_notes: Applications are graded from 0.000 to 5.000 on three criteria: Criterion A, merit of the applicant (30%), Criterion B, merit of the work plan (40%) and Criterion C, merit of the hosting conditions (30%). Applicant merit is split equally between academic career (50%) and personal CV (50%). Ranking is by weighted average, with tie-breaks in the order Criterion B, then Criterion A, then Criterion C. Applications scoring below 3.000 are not eligible for a studentship.
existing.best_fit: Candidates who are enrolled in or eligible to enter a PhD programme, can be hosted by an academic or eligible R&D institution able to act as Contracting Institution, and are seeking a fully funded doctoral position in Portugal or abroad.
existing.application_period: Annual. The 2026 cycle ran 2 to 31 March 2026 (closing 17:00 Lisbon time). A separate line of application for research work plans carried out mainly in non-academic institutions exists within the same call.
existing.deadline_display: Official wording: "The Call is open from March 2nd to 5:00 pm (Lisbon time) March 31st, 2026." FCT adds that the call "takes place each year in March or, occasionally, between March and April", but no 2027 dates had been published on the page as of 2026-10-04.
existing.program_type: National public research funding call for doctoral studentships
